sources.title: How to peer review
sources.author: Matt Might
adopted: Record first-pass confusion and revisit later clarification
Give specific, actionable repair rather than only a negative judgment
not_adopted: Personal punctuation or scheduling preferences as scientific gates

sources.title: Review anti-patterns
sources.author: Prem Devanbu
sources.access: authored advice reproduced on university site
adopted: Locate the exact prior result behind a novelty objection
Explain the flaw and what evidence or change would resolve it
not_adopted: Treat hosted advice as journal policy

sources.title: How to write a report
sources.author: Nature
sources.access: primary-site search-index excerpt; full-page open redirected unsuccessfully
adopted: Validity and significance are distinct assessments
Use technical evidence, methods and appropriate additional tests
not_adopted: Generalize Nature importance and readership criteria to all journals

sources.title: Guide to referees
sources.author: Scientific Reports
sources.access: primary-site search-index excerpt; full-page open redirected unsuccessfully
adopted: Technical validity rather than perceived importance as a selection criterion
not_adopted: Drop ethics, originality or validity because the venue is soundness-focused

sources.title: Guidelines for Reviewers
sources.author: PLOS ONE
adopted: Review rigor and supported conclusions rather than perceived importance
Use article-stage criteria for protocols and registered reports
not_adopted: Require final results from a study-protocol manuscript
